first_failing_invariant: the host-upload registry is never populated, so no binding can retain bytes
package_refusal: Draw package for draw 11 refused: a descriptor interface declares a binding with no captured resource
tape_refusal: the tape could not be built: draw_unresolved

defects.name: host-upload registry never populated
defects.cause: declared and implemented but called from nowhere, so g_host_uploads stays empty and FindHostUploadForBinding always fails
defects.effect: every ordinary binding records GuestMemoryObserved and retains no bytes

defects.name: isolated read-constant path retains no bytes
defects.cause: sets captured_bytes and captured_hash but never retained_offset or retained_bytes
defects.effect: 616 of 770 bindings are host-verified and unusable by the exporter

defects.name: validator resolves descriptors in the wrong domain
defects.cause: image and sampler classes were looked for in package.bindings, but images live in package.textures and samplers in package.samplers
defects.effect: a package whose images were captured perfectly would be rejected

defects.name: readiness accepted a partial binding set
defects.cause: readiness was !package.bindings.empty(), and a binding with no resource was skipped rather than failing
defects.effect: one captured binding beside three missing ones read as ready

defects.name: descriptor resolution was permutation-scoped
defects.cause: the resolution iterated every retained interface and applied the most recent pipeline's binding bases, but a permutation is reusable across pipelines with different stage combinations
defects.effect: a later pipeline silently corrupted an earlier draw's mapping

defects.name: image arrays were validated as consecutive bindings
defects.cause: element_binding = descriptor.binding + element, but a descriptor with descriptorCount = N is one binding with N elements
defects.effect: binding B with elements 0 and 1 was indistinguishable from bindings B and B+1

defects.name: sampler deduplication discarded binding identity
defects.cause: deduplicated on (guest_hash, stage_hash), which describes state reuse rather than descriptor-binding identity
defects.effect: identical state at a second binding was dropped while the capture reported itself complete

descriptor_model.declaration: immutable: program hash, permutation, logical stage, local declarations, push constants
descriptor_model.pipeline_mapping: per pipeline: stage base and count, resolved flag, problem
descriptor_model.pipeline_identity: derived from the pipeline key's stage hashes
descriptor_model.array_semantics: one binding with descriptorCount elements, addressed by array_element
descriptor_model.sampler_identity: state plus draw provenance, stage, binding, element and associated image

rhi04r3.serialization: schema 4 unchanged; new fields are additive and default to not-established
own_bugs_found_by_tests: the pipeline table was searched in full rather than over live entries, so a stale slot with a colliding id was overwritten outside the live range

defects.name: interface capture used a per-stage binding counter
defects.cause: BuildDescSetLayout allocates one counter across every stage in logical-stage order, but the capture reset to zero per stage
defects.effect: the captured interface named the wrong binding for every stage after the first

defects.name: sampler identity was not captured
defects.cause: no binding number, and the validator accepted any sampler with a nonzero id
defects.effect: an unrelated sampler from another stage or draw could satisfy a declaration

defects.name: image arrays were not checked element by element
defects.cause: the check accepted one texture with content for a count-N descriptor
defects.effect: a partial array passed as complete

defects.name: the large-transfer upload path recorded nothing
defects.cause: NoteHostUpload was added only to the ordinary staging branch
defects.effect: a large one-time transfer could not become a package resource

binding_contract.local_binding: the shader's own declaration order, from zero
binding_contract.binding_resolved: whether the effective number was established
binding_contract.stage_binding_base: the global binding the layout started this stage at
binding_contract.stage_order: fragment (0) before vertex (3), as LogicalStage declares them
